status: development-exposed mechanism test; frozen before collection outcomes, then amended as recorded below

amendments.visible_before_change: The interrupted Standard-tier run had six completed task artifacts and one partial trace for tobymao__sqlglot-4165.
amendments.change: Restart all 48 tasks from the beginning with the Codex Fast tier requested; do not combine the interrupted Standard-tier artifacts with this run.
amendments.reason: Reduce collection wall time without changing the task set, concurrency, model, iteration cap, telemetry, or evaluation criterion.
amendments.evidence_boundary: HTTP and WebSocket smokes requested priority but the backend response reported service_tier=default. Treat the new run as requested_fast, not verified_fast, and retain response-reported tier metadata.

amendments.visible_before_change: The natural-c2 primary result was -1.639 seconds with a 95% task-pair interval of [-3.166, -0.105], all 24 task deletions remained negative, and a post-result mechanism audit found that 21 of 22 changed decisions had identical timeout signatures and none approached the timeout ceiling.
amendments.change: Freeze one synthetic-c32 follow-up over the same 24 fit and 24 evaluation tasks, with fixed arrival seeds 0 through 31, C100 versus tool-name only, paired schedule-bootstrap uncertainty, and exhaustive evaluation-task deletion stability.
amendments.reason: Test whether the natural-c2 same-repository advantage survives one predeclared high-concurrency arrival model before any live pressure experiment.
amendments.evidence_boundary: This is an openly post-result development follow-up. It reuses isolated durations and models neither contention nor KV eviction feedback.

source.selection: sort the repository's tasks by created_at and take zero-based rows [231:279]
source.selection_basis: repository task count, temporal locality, and collection cost; no task outcome was used

evaluation.question: Does dense task-disjoint same-repository history make CacheWise whole-argument clustering outperform a same-repository tool-name baseline?
evaluation.go_criterion: upper endpoint of the 95% task-pair cluster-bootstrap interval is below zero
evaluation.task_stability: repeat after removing each evaluation task; report any task whose removal changes the sign
evaluation.comparison_scope: identical eligible ranking events and task labels for all methods
evaluation.note: eBPF resource counters are collected for later mechanism analysis and do not select this primary result

synthetic_c32.question: Does the frozen SQLGlot C100 advantage survive fixed trace-driven synthetic concurrency?
synthetic_c32.fit_and_eval: reuse the configured 24 fit and 24 evaluation task IDs without refitting on evaluation tasks
synthetic_c32.arrival_model: shuffle sorted evaluation task IDs with NumPy default_rng(seed); open-loop interarrival is fit-median session gap span divided by 32; preserve within-session gap offsets and durations
synthetic_c32.primary_metric: mean over schedules of mean_regret_seconds(c100) - mean_regret_seconds(tool_name); lower is better
synthetic_c32.primary_go_criterion: upper endpoint of the 10,000-draw paired schedule-bootstrap 95% interval is below zero
synthetic_c32.task_stability_go_criterion: maximum schedule-mean primary delta after deleting each evaluation task is below zero
synthetic_c32.stop_rule: if either gate fails, stop before live pressure or scheduler experiments
synthetic_c32.evidence_boundary: isolated trace durations only; no contention, KV capacity, eviction, recomputation, or JCT feedback
